knowledge_points.name: 完形填空·词汇与语法辨析

knowledge_point_basis: 题型维度(E-T*) + 语言知识维度(E-G*/E-S*)，映射取自 knowledge_base.json 的 question_type_to_points
source: inbox/real_exams/*.json（只读；不从 SQLite 取题干）

rules.prefer: 有解析者优先；其次解析更长、空更多、材料更长
rules.sampling: 按 exam 轮转（每套卷先取 1 条再取第 2 条…），上限 40 条
rules.dedupe: 同题干（去空白差异）只留解析最好的一条，其余来源记在 same_stem_exams
rules.material_rule: 材料型题整组存：material 存整篇原文、material_blanks 存该组全部空（空数经断言校验）；材料型 sample 的 stem 为空串，题干在各空的 stem 里
rules.zero_rewrite: 题干/材料/答案/解析零改写；唯一渲染是把源里的 {type:'blank'} 块显式写成 {{__BLANK_<n>__}}；连词成句保留 `词组 / 词组` 斜杠格式
rules.deterministic: 不使用随机数；排序键固定为 (exam, 组内 rank)

Have you ever been in a conversation where the other person wasn't really listening to what you were saying? Maybe they were distracted {{__BLANK_31__}} about their own response, or just not interested. It is annoying and even discouraging. But active listening is a way to ensure that all parties are heard and understood.

Active listening is a skill that requires focus, patience, and {{__BLANK_32__}} open mind. Here, we will discuss the basic elements of active listening, techniques to become an active listener, and why it's important in our daily life.

Active listening is a practice that promotes mutual understanding and effective communication. It involves focusing {{__BLANK_33__}} the speaker and fully comprehending their message. This goes beyond just hearing; it {{__BLANK_34__}} engagement and attention to detail. By actively listening, we show respect to the speaker and create an environment {{__BLANK_35__}} open and honest communication can continue smoothly.

Being present is vital when practicing active listening, {{__BLANK_36__}} it involves being fully engaged in the conversation. Non-verbal clues, such as body language and facial expressions, play a significant {{__BLANK_37__}} in enhancing active listening by providing context and aiding in the explanation of the speaker's message. Maintaining eye contact demonstrates respect, interest, and attentiveness towards the speaker, while body language can show emotions, attitudes, and intentions that words may not express. Active listening calls for giving undivided attention and avoiding distractions, ensuring that the speaker feels {{__BLANK_38__}} and heard. By using these basic elements, we can truly connect with others and make effective communication.

Active listening techniques are essential for {{__BLANK_39__}} deeper conversations and effective problem-solving. These techniques include:



$\diamond$ Asking open-ended questions;

$\Leftrightarrow$ Reflecting on-and paraphrasing-what is heard;

Listening {{__BLANK_40__}} without interrupting.

These techniques, when practiced, enhance the quality of interactions and strengthen relationships. Adding these techniques to your listening skills can have a great influence on your communication abilities.

samples.material:
It's not quite true that a great salesperson can sell anything to anyone. For a start, they might not need it—and selling is all about meeting needs. {{__BLANK_31__}}, selling is one of those things that can happen to anyone, no {{__BLANK_32__}} what their job description, so here are the basics.
STEP 1 Build trust
You need to {{__BLANK_33__}} trust with the person to whom you are selling. They don't have to be your best friend but essentially people don't buy from people they hate or distrust.
STEP 2 Don't misunderstand the customer
Understand the needs of the other person. Then it's up to the salesperson to demonstrate that the benefits of their goods or services match the requirements. Without that, you have no sale.
STEP 3 Ask clever questions
Ask questions to find out what the customer's problems and issues are. Then think {{__BLANK_34__}} what the needs must be. It's often more {{__BLANK_35__}} than asking "what do you need?"
STEP 4 Know your stuff
It {{__BLANK_36__}} without saying: know your product and understand the marketplace into which you are selling.
STEP 5 Don't overload people with details
You need to know every product specification but your customer doesn't. Essentially, he or she needs to know how it will make their life {{__BLANK_37__}}. If later on they want more details, they will find it on your website.
STEP 6 Salespeople are not necessarily born
The classic {{__BLANK_38__}} of a salesperson is someone who is outgoing. But like customers who come in all personality types, salespeople can vary. The main thing is to be able to reflect and react to a customer's personality.
STEP 7 Be prepared to fail
It doesn't matter how good you are, you will get {{__BLANK_39__}}. Selling is full of setbacks, so don't get hung up on it. {{__BLANK_40__}} on to the next customer.

# V. Writing (15.points) 参考范文
# My view on happiness
With the development of our society, we are having much more happiness than ever before. For a student like me, happiness is never a thing far reaching. Instead, it is appearing in every corner of our life.
During the preparation of this examination, my parents, friends and teachers have given me tremendous help. I still remember the day when I was studying at night, I happened to notice that my mother was actually waiting for me in the living room with my dinner, without telling me.
There are many ways to reach happiness. Firstly, we should pay more attention on things around us. Secondly, happiness is not all about receiving but sometimes about giving.
Spend more time with families and friends; do volunteer works instead of always waiting for help. Only then, can we embrace happiness.

As early as our late {{__BLANK_31__}}, our brains start losing neurons and even start to become weaker once we reach 65. This may sound {{__BLANK_32__}}, but it happens to everyone. The good news is that there are many things we can do to age-proof our brains. The more active our brains are, the {{__BLANK_33__}} they'll be affected by aging. Here are four simple suggestions that will give your brain good exercise.
## Be social
Research has found that being social is one of the keys to living a long and happy life. {{__BLANK_34__}} does socializing help to improve one's mood and mental well-being, it can also prevent memory loss in later life. Social interaction keeps our brains mentally engaged.
## Play sports and go dancing
It's important to develop the areas of the brain that {{__BLANK_35__}} it to the body. Movement improves brain function {{__BLANK_36__}} a number of levels and helps to develop motor skills. It also boosts our memories and strengthens neuronal networks.
## Play an instrument
Research has shown a person who has played an instrument for more than 10 years will have a much better memory than someone who hasn't. It also helps children become more self-disciplined, attentive, and better at planning. Playing an instrument makes us better at processing sound, {{__BLANK_37__}} musicians are very good at understanding how people feel based on the tone of their voice.
## Learn another language
Bilingual brains work much harder than monolingual brains. Learning another language builds gray matter in the brain, {{__BLANK_38__}} controls many of the brain's functions, including sensory perception, memory, and {{__BLANK_39__}} making.
The most important thing is to challenge your brain as often as you can. Studies have shown that {{__BLANK_40__}} brushing your teeth with your "wrong" hand stimulates your brain!

material_blanks.explanation: `in one's late twenties` 为固定表达。
`sound + 形容词`，且这里表示“听起来令人害怕”。
结构是 “the more..., the less...”。
`Not only ... but also ...` 为固定搭配。
`connect ... to ...` 符合语义与搭配。
`on a number of levels` 是固定说法。
前后句是因果递进关系。
逗号后是非限制性定语从句，只能用 `which`。
`decision making` 是固定搭配。
`even` 表示“甚至”。

samples.explanation:
It is normal that... 是固定句式，that 引导真正主语从句，故选 C。

前句说紧张很正常，后句强调仍要保持冷静，自然是转折关系，应选 However。

consist of 是固定搭配，表示“由……组成”，与后面的 several tasks 搭配正确。

research the school as well as the expectations... 表示“也要研究岗位要求”，D 最合适。

as much information as you can 是固定表达，表示“尽可能多的信息”。

前文用了 First、Second，这里顺承列举步骤，应为 Finally。

make sure that... 是固定搭配，表示“务必确保……”，故选 D。

practice doing sth. 是固定用法，所以用 answering。

先行词是 friends，后面缺少限定 advice 的关系代词，应使用 whose advice。

句意是“你可以在网上找到一些潜在的面试问题”，用 some 最自然。

Interviews are an important and necessary part of going for a new job. It is normal {{__BLANK_31__}} you will feel nervous at an interview. {{__BLANK_32__}}, it is important to remain calm and confident. Remember, your application impressed the school hence your invitation to interview.
Typically, a teaching interview will {{__BLANK_33__}} of a teaching task, an evaluation task and a formal interview with an interview panel.
## Preparation is key!
First, ensure you research the school before the interview {{__BLANK_34__}} the expectations of the job role itself (although you would have already done research as part of your application!). Second, pay a visit to the school website and find out as much information {{__BLANK_35__}} you can, such as the school's values, the type of school and recent school news. {{__BLANK_36__}}, download the school's most recent official report and look carefully for your improvement.
## Pay A Visit
If you have not yet visited the school then make {{__BLANK_37__}} that you do so before the interview. Visiting the school gives you a real insight into the day-to-day routines and atmosphere in the school. It will also give you the opportunity to talk to staff and students.
## Practice Makes Perfect
For any job interview, not just teaching, it is always advisable to practice {{__BLANK_38__}} some interview questions prior to the real thing! To conduct a practice interview, you can ask your friends, {{__BLANK_39__}} advice will be honest and useful. You could take it a step further by filming the interview and watching it back yourself to see how you could improve. You can find {{__BLANK_40__}} potential teaching interview questions online including in our blog!
## First Impressions Matter
From the moment you step into the school building, judgments are already being formed. Smile, show enthusiasm, ask questions and strike up conversations. Remain positive and confident.

samples.material:
Have you ever been in a conversation where the other person wasn't really listening to what you were saying? Maybe they were distracted{{__BLANK_31__}}about their own response, or just not interested. It is annoying and even discouraging. But active listening is a way to ensure that all parties are heard and understood.

Active listening is a skill that requires focus, patience, and{{__BLANK_32__}}open mind. Here, we will discuss the basic elements of active listening, techniques to become an active listener, and why it's important in our daily life.

Active listening is a practice that promotes mutual understanding and effective communication. It involves focusing{{__BLANK_33__}}the speaker and fully comprehending their message. This goes beyond just hearing; it{{__BLANK_34__}}engagement and attention to detail. By actively listening, we show respect to the speaker and create an environment{{__BLANK_35__}}open and honest communication can continue smoothly.

Being present is vital when practicing active listening,{{__BLANK_36__}}it involves being fully engaged in the conversation. Non-verbal clues, such as body language and facial expressions, play a significant{{__BLANK_37__}}in enhancing active listening by providing context and aiding in the explanation of the speaker's message. Maintaining eye contact demonstrates respect, interest, and attentiveness towards the speaker, while body language can show emotions, attitudes, and intentions that words may not express. Active listening calls for giving undivided attention and avoiding distractions, ensuring that the speaker feels{{__BLANK_38__}}and heard. By using these basic elements, we can truly connect with others and make effective communication.

Active listening techniques are essential for{{__BLANK_39__}}deeper conversations and effective problem-solving. These techniques include:
- Asking open-ended questions;
- Reflecting on and paraphrasing what is heard;
- Listening{{__BLANK_40__}}without interrupting.

These techniques, when practiced, enhance the quality of interactions and strengthen relationships. Adding these techniques to your listening skills can have a great influence on your communication abilities.
